passages.context: The complete English motu proprio, including the account of the 30 June 1988 episcopal ordinations, the declaration of the schismatic act and excommunications, the diagnosis of an incomplete and contradictory notion of Tradition, the institution of the Ecclesia Dei Commission, and the call for a wide and generous application of the 1984 directives on the 1962 Missal, whose footnote identifies the letter Quattuor abhinc annos of 3 October 1984.
passages.notes: The complete delivery was structurally inspected; no comparison with a printed Acta witness is claimed.

work.author: Pope John Paul II
work.description: John Paul II's apostolic letter given motu proprio on 2 July 1988 after the episcopal ordinations conferred by Archbishop Marcel Lefebvre on 30 June 1988, declaring the act schismatic, analyzing its root in an incomplete and contradictory notion of Tradition, instituting the Ecclesia Dei Commission, and calling for a wide and generous application of the 1984 directives for use of the 1962 Roman Missal.
work.title: Ecclesia Dei
